title: Juan Franco
text: Hi, I’m Juan Franco. I’m a Senior Analyst Data Analyst at Royal Caribbean Group, and I’m completing an MS in Data Analytics at Boston University MET. This site is my course ePortfolio for AD688, Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business.

title: Juan Franco
text:
Environment check
The cell below runs PySpark directly on the AWS EC2 instance used throughout this course, and builds a small DataFrame to confirm the Spark session starts and executes.

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = (
    SparkSession.builder
    .appName("PortfolioDemo")
    .master("local[*]")
    .getOrCreate()
)
spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")

courses = spark.createDataFrame(
    [
        ("AD688", "Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business", 2026),
        ("AD699", "Data Mining for Business Analytics", 2026),
        ("AD632", "Financial Concepts", 2025),
    ],
    ["course_code", "course_title", "year"],
)

courses.show(truncate=False)

spark.stop()
